P2: the Engine::search_text_only public Rust doc now states that direct text-only results come from node- and edge-body FTS branches.

implementation.preserved_behavior: Hybrid requests pass None and retain their prior query_vector.is_none() final-limit fallback candidate behavior.
unchanged: body deduplication/ranking and final result truncation

The record contains the fixture, revisions, host, SQLite/schema, raw timings, and raw IDs; it makes no generalized performance claim.

environment_notes: The shared Python extension exposed an obsolete 0.8.0 surface without the released limit keyword. RED/GREEN Python tests therefore used locally built, non-editable wheels installed only into temporary virtual environments; no shared editable binding was changed.
The TypeScript native build required sandbox escalation because napi-rs invokes /bin/sh. It built only in this isolated worktree.
next_step: Independent code review. Apply named FIX-n commits for every P1/P2 finding, then let the release orchestrator decide integration and update release state; do not tag or publish here.
